name: SlideVQA: Document Visual Question Answering on Multiple Images
description: SlideVQA is a multi-page document visual question answering benchmark built upon real-world presentation slide decks. Unlike single-page document VQA, SlideVQA requires multimodal models to search across an entire slide deck to locate relevant evidence slides and perform multi-hop numerical, visual, and textual reasoning, comprising 14,500 question-answer pairs over 2,619 slide decks totaling 52,480 slide images.
